posts.description: Long time NBA fan here, since 1996 when Jordan beat Seattle and Kobe got drafted. posts.title: Sandwich Review in NYC #40 (Court Street Grocers)
posts.description: I just discovered this they were only a couple blocks away from my kid's daycare in Carroll Gardens--not sure why I haven't been sooner. Did I tell you I've been running lately? I bought some new shoes and I run after I do dropoff. Our home is 2 stops away on train so it's about a 20-25 min run. It's nice. I'm trying to be healthy and all that. I still want to eat a big-ass greasy sandwich though.
